notes: Floor/desktop unit (47 x 26 x 8.5 cm, ~4.6 kg) — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Cross-verified against the manufacturer's technical-specifications page (kemper-amps.com/profiler/technical-specifications) and Kemper's own full PROFILER manual (rear-panel chapter "Back Panel Overview Stage"), which agree. Main Output is 4 separate physical jacks (2x XLR balanced + 2x 1/4" TS unbalanced for L/R), confirmed as discrete connectors (not combo) via an independent press teardown (Sound On Sound review) — not stated as combo in the manual. Return 1 and 2 can double as a stereo Aux/mp3 input via a 3.5mm-TRS-to-dual-1/4"-TS cable, but the physical device jacks remain 1/4" TRS. Unlike the Head/Rack/PowerHead/PowerRack variants, the Stage has NO Ethernet/RJ45 port (manufacturer manual explicitly states "Network: RJ45 connector (not applicable on PROFILER Stage)"). USB is specified by Kemper as "USB 2.0 (FS)"; mapped to grade usb-2.0. Currently-sold unit is the "PROFILER Stage (MK 2)" — Kemper states the MK2 refresh is a DSP/firmware/feature upgrade (more onboard effects, Liquid Profiling, faster boot) with no reported change to the physical connector panel versus the original Stage. A Kensington lock slot exists on the rear panel but is a physical security fitting, not a signal/power connector, so it is omitted from the port list.
